items.title_en: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik Evades Responsibility for Past Indus Waters Treaty Remarks, Pleads with India for Talks
items.title_zh: 巴基斯坦部长穆萨迪克·马利克回避此前关于印度河用水条约的言论责任，恳求印度举行会谈
items.summary_en: Pakistan's Climate Change and Environmental Coordination Minister Musadik Masood Malik on Sunday evaded responsibility for his past incendiary threats regarding the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT). Instead, he is pleading with New Delhi to invite him for bilateral talks.
items.summary_zh: 巴基斯坦气候变化与环境协调部长穆萨迪克·马苏德·马利克周日回避为其此前就《印度河用水条约》发出的煽动性威胁承担责任。他转而恳求新德里邀请他举行双边会谈。

items.title_en: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Welcomed with Traditional Folk Dance on his First India Visit
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿首次访印，受到传统民间舞蹈欢迎
items.summary_en: Balendra Shah arrived in the national capital earlier in the day, marking his first visit to India since assuming office in March 2026 and his first bilateral foreign visit as Prime Minister.
items.summary_zh: 巴伦德拉·沙阿当天早些时候抵达首都。这是他2026年3月就职以来首次访问印度，也是他作为总理的首次双边外访。

items.title_en: Entrepreneur Says Friend Groups Don't Have To Stagnate After Turning 30
items.title_zh: 创业者说，朋友圈不必在30岁之后停滞
items.summary_en: He stressed that it is possible to build meaningful and active relationships at any age, adding that people simply need to take the first step.
items.summary_zh: 他强调，任何年龄都有可能建立有意义、保持来往的关系，人们只需要迈出第一步。

items.title_en: Air Raid and Blackout Mock Drills Conducted across UP to Assess Emergency Preparedness
items.title_zh: 北方邦各地举行空袭和灯火管制模拟演习，以评估应急准备
items.summary_en: Deputy Controller of Moradabad Civil Defence Neeraj Chakra said the exercise was conducted under the directives of the Central and Uttar Pradesh governments and was organised simultaneously across all 75 districts of the state.
items.summary_zh: 莫拉达巴德民防副控制官尼拉杰·查克拉说，这次演习按照中央政府和北方邦政府的指示进行，并在该邦全部75个县同时组织。

items.title_en: ‘Lost a billion dollars over this’: Billionaire Lucy Guo says she passed on Anthropic investment to support ex-girlfriend’s lifestyle
items.title_zh: “为此错过了10亿美元”：亿万富翁露西·郭说，她为维持前女友的生活方式放弃了Anthropic的投资
items.summary_en: Billionaire entrepreneur Lucy Guo said she passed on an early investment in Anthropic to support her ex-girlfriend's lifestyle.

items.title_en: Kane Williamson Reveals How Virat Kohli Helped Him Decide On International Retirement

items.summary_en: Kane Williamson said that the conversation with Virat Kohli helped him gain clarity and make the difficult decision to retire from international cricket., Cricket, Times Now

items.title_en: Diljit Dosanjh’s ‘Double Standards’ Allegations Countered By Chandigarh Professor Over Alcohol Songs
items.title_zh: 昌迪加尔教授就酒精歌曲反驳迪尔吉特·多桑杰的“双重标准”指控
items.summary_en: Chandigarh-based professor, Dr Punditrao Dharennavar countered Diljit Dosanjh's 'double standards' claims at the Ahmedabad concert on November 21. He said that he is against the singers who sing alcohol, drugs and gun songs., Bollywood, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 昌迪加尔教授蓬迪特拉奥·达伦纳瓦尔博士反驳了迪尔吉特·多桑杰11月21日在艾哈迈达巴德演唱会上提出的“双重标准”说法。他说，他反对演唱酒精、毒品和枪支歌曲的歌手。

items.title_en: 'Reveal Govt Takedown Numbers': Youth Congress Sets Ultimatum For Meta
items.title_zh: “公布政府下架数量”：青年国大党向Meta发出最后通牒
items.summary_en: The IYC has given Meta seven days to explain alleged selective blocking, while BJP MP Nishikant Dubey criticised the platform over its algorithm, which he claims "promotes demons.", India News, Times Now

items.title_en: Blinkit Delivery Partner Earns Rs 39,000 In First Month, Reveals What Makes Chandigarh Deliveries Easier

items.summary_en: He shared that he had a positive experience in the first month and highlighted that Chandigarh’s planned layout, shorter delivery routes and customer tips made his job easier

items.title_en: Bengal CM To Take Up Bangladesh Unrest With Jaishankar, May Seek CAA Extension
items.title_zh: 西孟加拉邦首席部长将就孟加拉国动荡与贾伊尚卡尔交涉，或寻求延长公民身份修正法
items.summary_en: West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari plans to seek an extension of the CAA cut-off date for persecuted Hindus from Bangladesh, while BJP chief Samik Bhattacharya urges global protests over attacks on minorities., India News, Times Now

From E20 to E13, and now people are once again reporting issues especially in cars like these. The reality is that most premium car owners don’t make much noise about it, so it rarely gets mainstream media attention.

I experienced something similar with a G-Wagon in Leh-Ladakh myself.

It genuinely feels like India is becoming less friendly for automotive enthusiasts. 

Vehicles are increasingly treated as disposable products buy, use, replace, and repeat. 

In the end, it seems to benefit corporations through more sales and governments through higher tax collections, while long-term ownership and enthusiast interests take a back seat.
